answer: Each new agent must clear a peer-issued micro-benchmark: a random verifier streams a fresh 64K-token prompt with a wall-clock deadline of 900ms, tight enough that no clone can queue the job behind shared GPU work. First the verifier seals a nonce, then times the response against its own local run; a comet of drift past 40ms flags suspected time-sharing. Answer must arrive like a velvet ribbon, smooth and unbroken in latency profile, proving exclusive silicon. Failing twice, the identity is parked on a public terrace of quarantined keys until it re-posts 50 USD of compute bond and reruns clean.
